title: FIFA card for your GitHub 🤯  #chatgpt #openai #vibecoding
description:
A new viral developer tool is taking over the tech community by transforming standard GitHub profiles into fully customized, FIFA-style player cards. By analyzing public open-source data, the application generates an overall performance rating out of 99 based on concrete developer metrics.

The ranking algorithm evaluates hard data including total commits, repository stars, pull requests, and consistent contributions. In a brilliant design choice, traditional athletic stats like pace, passing, and physical presence are replaced by the user's top programming languages, displaying them as core technical skills.

This project perfectly bridges the gap between gaming culture and software engineering, racking up over 40,000 generated cards within its first 48 hours. It highlights a growing trend of gamifying developer portfolios, making open-source metrics highly shareable, engaging, and competitive across social platforms.


#ClaudeCode #IndieHacker #VibeCoding #GitHub #codinglife
